newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to redeem $450 mln in issues.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to redeem $450 mln in issues.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Tuesday it will redeem four issues of callable notes having a par value totalling $450 million as follows.
Sallie Mae said principal and final interest payments on the issues will be due and payable on Dec 26 to holders of record at the close of business on December 24.
The notes will be repaid at 100 pct of face amount.

In addition, Sallie Mae said that for the 7.00 percent notes it will pay an accrued interest of $35 per $1,000 face amount on Dec 26. For the 7.09 percent notes, it will pay $35.45 per $1,000, for the 6.375 percent notes it will pay $31.875 per $1,000, and for the 6.615 percent notes it will pay $33.075 per $1,000 face amount, all on Dec 26.
